https://mastodon.social/@DigiVoyager/117.text: Played Perfect Dark. Maybe I will do a detailed writeup of it and GoldenEye someday. So far, like the setting, soundtrack, level design and atmosphere far more than Goldeneye. Hard to believe they achieved this on the 64, shows how much the low inbuilt memory hampered the console. I completed all 3 parts of M1: DataDyne, stopped playing after that because am not sure if clunker 4460 overheating makes the game lag or if it has such bad performance naturally, probably both. #gaming #retrogaming

https://mastodon.social/@arda@micro.arda.text: Weekend chilling with my AYN Thor (Max): Playing Castlevania: Dawn of Sorrow. GBA / NDS / 3DS were lost generations for me (I was a hardcore PC gamer back then), so trying to catch up feels nice for these generations. It has Amoled touch screen, mine has 8 cores + 16gbs RAM, 1TB SSD. It can even emulate Switch games, plus it literally can play PC games using GameNative/Winlator etc, just like Steam Deck. It can even emulate PS3 and Xbox360. https://www.ayntec.com/products/ayn-thor?variant=46692546838720 #aynthor #retrogaming
